summary: A country in the Caucasus between the Black Sea and Azerbaijan, one of the oldest Christian nations. It left the Soviet Union in 1991, and parts of its territory remain disputed.

events.note: Dated from 1008, when Bagrat III united the Georgian lands in one kingdom. The kingdom broke up in the fifteenth century and Russia annexed the region from 1801.

events.label: First republic
events.note: The Democratic Republic of Georgia was declared; the Red Army took it in 1921.

events.label: Independence
events.note: Georgia left the Soviet Union, having declared independence on 9 April 1991.
